title: Implement formatting and unchanged-span preservation

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 formatting and unchanged-span preservation assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current Python forest already provides AnalyticalChangeTransformer@1. It preserves caller-supplied surrounding span text while rendering closed edits, binds the supplied span and replacement with SHA-256 hashes, emits versioned canonical receipts with CIDv1 DAG-JSON replay identities, deterministically orders batches, and is proposal-only. Under the exact receipt-only authority no source delta is allowed or needed. This component is not a current-forest PCSM source linker: it never opens or writes files and does not establish an aggregate source-map CID or prove byte preservation outside a supplied span.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable formatter has sealed positive and negative test coverage, but PCSM-051 and PCSM-052 establish that the required forest-wide SourceMapResolver@1 and SourceLinkReceipt@1 remain absent. Therefore this receipt records the verified local formatting capability without promoting it to a source-forest rewrite authority.

pcsm_source_map.reason: PCSM-051 records SourceMapResolver@1 and SourceLinkReceipt@1 as unavailable, and PCSM-052 records no aggregate current-forest source-map CID. A caller-supplied TransformSourceSpan hash, a Git blob, or a source SHA-256 is not a substitute for a current forest-wide source map.

required_capability_assessment.required_capability: Deterministic Python formatting and unchanged-span preservation for closed, authority-bound edit spans
binding_and_determinism: TransformSourceSpan requires a normalized relative path, exact half-open character bounds, exact caller-supplied span text, and sha256(span_text); a mismatch rejects as stale_span.
TransformEdit repeats path, bounds, artifact identity, before hash, replacement, and sha256(replacement); an inconsistent expected-after hash rejects.
Canonical receipts inherit CIDv1 DAG-JSON/sha2-256 content identities, and TransformRenderReceipt derives a replay identity from its canonical payload.
Rendering is a pure function of the supplied span text and closed parameters; render_many sorts by site content identity rather than input order.
Closed renderers preserve surrounding text in their supplied span and return the supplied text unchanged for supported already-present no-op forms.
required_capability_assessment.authority_boundary: The component never opens or writes repository files. It requires authority roots, proof/obligation and target-decision checks where applicable, returns proposals/receipts only, and grants no edit for rejected transforms.
required_capability_assessment.non_equivalence_to_forest_linker: The component receives a caller-supplied span and artifact identifier. It does not resolve a canonical PCSM identity to a current file/node/span, compare that span to a source forest, materialize rewritten file bytes, or emit unchanged-byte evidence for regions outside the supplied span.
required_capability_assessment.disposition: The local capability is implemented, versioned, deterministic, and sealed-test-covered. Promotion to PCSM current-forest formatting/unchanged-byte preservation is unavailable until the missing source-map/linker contract binds those supplied spans to the exact forest.

source_inventory.role: AnalyticalChangeTransformer@1; versioned closed Python-span renderer with stale-span hashing, byte-stable replay, formatting-preserving rendering, deterministic batch order, and proposal-only authority.

Focused positive and negative tests for the existing formatter, including spacing preservation, idempotence, stale-span rejection, deterministic replay, hashes, authority roots, and fail-closed unsupported shapes.
The general required supervisor suite reached through test/agent_supervisor/pcsm; it is independent structured-decoding coverage, not formatter coverage.

positive_coverage: keyword and positional argument rendering preserve observed spacing style
repeated rendering is byte-equivalent and yields the same replay identity and canonical record
before and after hashes bind exact source and replacement text
negative_coverage: dynamic splats and unsupported syntax reject
ambiguous overloads and non-total mappings reject
stale before hashes reject as stale_span
non-unique values, expression/root mismatches, invented behavior, new dependencies, unauthorized paths, missing proofs, and scope escapes reject
rejected transforms grant neither target paths nor edits
formatter_positive_and_negative_coverage.scope_limit: The vectors prove supplied-span rendering, not forest-wide unchanged-byte preservation or source-map resolution.

limitations: This task is receipt-only under exact declared-output authority; no implementation or test source was changed.
AnalyticalChangeTransformer@1 preserves formatting only within a supplied closed span and never reads or writes source files.
The span uses character offsets and a SHA-256 before hash; without the unavailable source map it is not proof that an arbitrary caller-supplied span is current in the complete PCSM forest.
No aliases are accepted as canonical source identity, and no M2/M3 mutation, generated-source mutation, or automatic source materialization is authorized.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
